en:
Keebo is on to something! Isn't it weird that
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hydraulic press stopped for a second<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?

Because when Keebo and I first investigated
that hydraulic press...

Yes, that's right! The hydraulic press kept
lowering itself without stopping!

The hydraulic press stopped briefly...right
before it crushed the body!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Why did the press stop?
There's only one reason I can think of.
